steps.en: Install the search core and point it at GCP projects with Claude on Vertex AI
steps.zh: 装好搜索核心，配上开通了 Vertex Claude 的 GCP 项目

steps.en: Pick or write a Domain adapter: task splits, run/score, leakage patterns, the harness dir
steps.zh: 选用或自写 Domain 适配器：任务划分、跑分、泄题模式

steps.en: Measure the unevolved harness once, then start the rounds
steps.zh: 先给原始 harness 测一次基线，再开跑多轮搜索
steps.code: python3 rrsi.py --domain <name> baseline · python3 rrsi.py --domain <name> run

steps.en: Reads trajectories and drafts at most b_t tagged edits per candidate in its own git worktree
steps.zh: 读轨迹，在独立 worktree 里起草至多 b_t 处带标签的改动

steps.en: Rejects diffs that encode task names, answers or grader paths before any evaluation is spent
steps.zh: 评测前先驳回写进任务名、答案或评分路径的改动

steps.en: Scores survivors on the full evolve set; keeps a gain only above the noise band and worth its tokens
steps.zh: 全量评测幸存者，只收越过噪声带且值回 token 的提升

steps.en: Fast-forwards evolve/<name> to the winner and logs every edit with its measured effect
steps.zh: 把 evolve/<name> 快进到胜者，逐条记录改动及实测效果

component.zh: git 分支 + 编辑历史

value.en: You stop hand-tuning the scaffold and stop mistaking noise or memorised tasks for progress; the incumbent is a commit with an audit trail
value.zh: 不再手调脚手架，也不再把噪声或背题当进步；当前最优是一个带审计记录的 commit

sources: https://github.com/google-research/rrsi README (Quickstart: pip install -e ".[dev]", RRSI_VERTEX_PROJECTS, rrsi.py --domain <name> smoke/baseline/run/status; Adding a domain: domains/<name>/adapter.py; Key features: git worktrees on evolve/<domain>)
rrsi/gitops.py (worktree per candidate, fast_forward of evolve/<domain>)
rrsi/critic.py (deterministic denylist + LLM review before evaluation)
